title: The Quiet Cathedral
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The cathedral of St. Anne has been silent for a generation — the organ broken, the choir dismissed, the bell rung only for the dead. When the new organist, 29-year-old Miriam, is hired to rebuild the instrument, she discovers the silence was a choice, and the choice was her grandfather\'s.
